NONE: B2 used when something happens that does not usually happen
› used to say that you will only do or request something on this particular occasion
B1 again, as has happened before
C2 completely and in a way that will finally solve a problem
徹底了結地；一勞永逸地
› only likely to happen once in a person's life
一生只有一次；千載難逢地；難得地
B1 in the past, but not now
B2 as soon as, or from the moment when

example: I went sailing once, but I didn't like it.
我玩過一次帆船，不過我不喜歡。
We have lunch together once a month.
我們每個月一起吃一次午餐。
They all started talking at once.
他們同時開始說起話來。
For once, the bus came on time.
難得一次公車準點到達。
All right, I'll lend you the money - just this once.
好吧，我把錢借給你——僅此一回。
Once again, racist attacks are increasing across Europe.
種族主義攻勢在整個歐洲又開始抬頭。
I'd like to visit the campus once more before we leave.
我想在我們離開之前再去參觀一下大學。
When my father came home, everything felt right once more.
當父親回到家時，一切又變好了。
I've seen him once or twice in town.
我在城裡見過他幾次。
We meet for lunch once in a while.
我們偶爾見面吃頓午餐。
Our intention is to destroy their offensive capability once and for all.
我們的目的是徹底摧毀他們的進攻能力。
An opportunity as good as this arises once in a lifetime.
像這樣好的機會可是千載難逢呀。

我只打過一次欖球，我再也不想打了。

這所房子曾屬於我的祖父。

如今電腦要比以前便宜多了。
Once-thriving villages stand deserted and in ruins.
昔日繁榮的村莊今遭廢棄，滿目瘡痍。
Once I've found somewhere to live I'll send you my address.
我一找到住的地方就把地址告訴你。
Remember that you won't be able to cancel the contract once you've signed.
記住一旦你簽了字就不能取消合約了。

我立刻知道我會喜歡這裡的。

NONE: › said when you are frightened to do something again because you had an unpleasant experience doing it the first time
一次被咬，下次膽小；一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩

example: My sister lives in Alaska, so I only see her once in a blue moon.
我姐姐住在阿拉斯加，所以我很少見到她。

NONE: B1 used at the beginning of children's stories to mean "a long time ago"
﹝用於兒童故事的開頭﹞從前，很久以前
› used when referring to something that happened in the past, especially when showing that you feel sorry that it no longer happens
（表示對過去的留戀）以往，從前

example: Once upon a time there was an ugly duckling.
從前，一隻很醜的鴨子。

從前，人們還知道是非曲直，可是如今似乎沒人在乎這些了。

example: A tour of Australia is a once-in-a-lifetime experience.
澳大利亞之行是一生難得的一次經歷。
